hook: Procession elephant panics in Old City; *no injuries*
hook_b: Procession elephant panics in Old City; *no injuries*
tldr: An elephant in the annual Gyarvi Shareef procession became agitated and moved uncontrollably through a crowded Old City street on Friday night.

beats.what: It happened near Etebar Chowk on Panjeshah Road, under Mir Chowk police limits, after the elephant came out of Irani Galli.
beats.why: The elephant suddenly became agitated during the procession, sending people running for safety.
beats.care: Mir Chowk police stepped in to disperse the crowd and prevent further mishaps.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Mahouts and handlers rushed in and restrained the animal.
